_note: The tutorial game (#236): seven protected days with Réal, the same seed at every difficulty. The croissants start low, 40 a day, so day 1 sells out around noon and « Hier » shows it on day 2; the café starts at 3,75 $, above what the habitués find fair, so some find it too expensive on day 2 and Réal points at it on day 3. The truck opens all seven days, since the game's day 0 is a Monday, which the content's starting decisions close. The steps' texts are the UI's (#238); each step says only which gesture completes it.
